A brief analysis of the above points follows:
1. Resource Use Recognition (Mining)
There were at least 15 of the incoming responses concerned with the status of mining vehicles on Interior lands. This was one of the issues which raised the most controversy - the question being whether Executive Order 11644 and the Departmental regulations applied to mining vehicles.
In summary, these comments were as follows:
#20 (a) American Mining Congress  objected to permits being required for mining vehicles.
#33 (b) American Petroleum Institute  wanted mining vehicles exempted from regulations and felt that environmental statement emphasis was almost entirely on recreational vehicles.
